prompt.project_info: Create a full-length environmental night portrait of an approved adult woman leaning against a white compact hatchback on a roadside.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman wearing a white long-sleeve top with tonal lace or embroidery at the chest, high-waisted grey straight-leg jeans, and blue thong sandals. She leans casually against the front of the car with relaxed posture.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-length vertical portrait with dusty gravel, blue corrugated gate, rustic structure, dark hillside, distant city lights, and white car clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh artificial light from upper left creates vertical lens-flare pillars and long hard shadows, with stark contrast against the dark background.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail night photography, vertical framing, sharp subject and car, realistic flash/floodlight falloff, natural proportions.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic full-length vertical night portrait of an approved adult woman leaning casually against the front fascia of a white compact hatchback. She wears a white long-sleeve embroidered top, high-waisted grey straight-leg jeans, and blue sandals. Place her on dusty gravel beside a rustic structure with a blue corrugated gate, dark hillside, and distant city lights. Use harsh upper-left artificial light, dramatic vertical lens-flare pillars, long hard shadows, and stark realistic contrast.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, random text, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted vehicle, excessive flare
